product_family: Cloud threat intelligence platform (Recorded Future Intelligence Platform) built on an Intelligence Graph, spanning modules for Attack Surface Intelligence, Third-Party Intelligence, Brand Intelligence, Identity Intelligence, Geopolitical Intelligence and SecOps Intelligence, plus Insikt Group human-analyst research and newer AI-driven 'Recorded Future AI' / Autonomous Threat Operations automation features. Acquired by Mastercard in December 2024 (previously majority-owned by Insight Partners).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Report on Recorded Future, Inc.'s Recorded Future Intelligence Platform Relevant to Security and Availability Throughout the Period of June 1, 2023 to May 31, 2024 -- SOC 3(R) - SOC for Service Organizations: Trust Services Criteria for General Use Report.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: ISO Certifications can be found here. ISO/IEC 27001:2022

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 (Privacy Information Management)
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27701:2019 ... Is Recorded Future GDPR compliant? Yes. Recorded Future complies with laws applicable to data protection and privacy, including the GDPR and CCPA, and is ISO 27701 certified.

certifications.name: ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management)
certifications.proof_quote: ISO Certifications can be found here. ... ISO 9001:2015

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. The vendor's own Security FAQ and GRC FAQ pages (which list ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 9001 and reference SOC 2) do not mention HIPAA or a Business Associate Agreement anywhere.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence that Recorded Future itself holds PCI DSS. The only PCI reference found relates to the underlying AWS infrastructure being PCI DSS certified -- that is the cloud host's certification, not Recorded Future's own.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not mentioned on the vendor's Security FAQ, GRC FAQ, or trust center overview; a FedRAMP Marketplace search returned no confirmed listing for Recorded Future.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on the vendor's own domain. A third-party aggregator site claims 'CSA Star Level 1' but this could not be corroborated on recordedfuture.com or the CSA STAR registry, so it is not counted here.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 (AI Management System)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Despite marketing an 'Autonomous Threat Operations' / 'Recorded Future AI' feature set, no AI-governance-specific certification (ISO 42001, CSA STAR AI) is referenced on the vendor's security or legal pages.

privacy.ai_training_note: Security FAQ states Recorded Future uses data in two ways: to deliver the service (queries, alerts, search history) and to use 'unattributed Customer Data' for 'development and improvement, including trend analysis and feature enhancement.' This is generic product-improvement language, not an explicit statement about training the newer 'Recorded Future AI' / Autonomous Threat Operations models, and no opt-out mechanism for this use is described publicly.
privacy.data_region: Primarily US-hosted on AWS ('Some of our Services are hosted in the United States'), with data centers described as globally distributed; cross-border transfers from the EEA/UK rely on Standard Contractual Clauses. No dedicated EU-only/regional hosting option is documented publicly.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: AES 256-bit encryption; customer data encrypted before database insertion on encrypted AWS EBS volumes with managed key infrastructure.

security.name: Secure software development
security.value: References alignment with NIST SSDF (SP 800-218) secure development practices alongside ISO 27001/9001-certified SDLC processes.

security.name: Access control / authentication
security.value: Multi-factor authentication, single sign-on support, automated account lockouts, restricted access to authorized personnel only.

security.name: Vulnerability management
security.value: Public bug bounty / Vulnerability Reporting Program via HackerOne, automated security scans, and regular penetration testing.

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Hosted on AWS data centers, described as housed separately from Recorded Future's own offices and distributed globally, with two-factor VPN access controls.

products.name: Recorded Future Intelligence Platform
products.data_scope: Ingests and correlates open web, dark web, technical, and human-source data into an Intelligence Graph; this is the system in scope for the published SOC 3 report.
products.notes: Core enterprise product; used by 1,900+ customers across 80+ countries per vendor homepage claims.

products.name: Insikt Group Research
products.data_scope: Analyst-authored reports and the annual 'State of Security' report; does not itself process customer data.
products.notes: Editorial/research arm, distinct data-handling profile from the live platform.

products.name: Recorded Future AI / Autonomous Threat Operations
products.data_scope: AI-assisted correlation, alert triage, and automated response layered on top of the core platform's Intelligence Graph.
products.notes: Newer product line; no separate published certification or explicit customer-data-training disclosure found for this specific AI layer.

products.name: Attack Surface / Third-Party / Brand / Identity Intelligence modules
products.data_scope: Domain, vendor-risk, brand-abuse, and credential-exposure monitoring built on the same core platform and data boundary.
products.notes: Marketed as modules of the single Intelligence Platform rather than separately certified products.

compare.pricing_model: Enterprise subscription, quote/demo-based (no public self-serve pricing).
compare.data_residency: AWS-hosted, primarily US, globally distributed data centers; SCCs used for EEA/UK transfers, no documented dedicated EU-region hosting option.

flags: Publicly posted SOC 3 report covers only the Security and Availability trust services categories (not Confidentiality, Processing Integrity, or Privacy) for the period June 1, 2023 to May 31, 2024; no more recent public SOC report was found, though a current attestation is likely available via the gated Conveyor trust center (unverified here).
Host-vs-vendor cert ambiguity: PCI DSS applies to the underlying AWS infrastructure, not to Recorded Future itself -- do not list PCI DSS as a Recorded Future certification.

Third-party aggregator sites (not the vendor) assert HIPAA, PCI, and CSA STAR Level 1 compliance for Recorded Future; none of this could be corroborated on recordedfuture.com or the relevant registries, so these are graded held=false here. Treat third-party compliance-scanner claims with caution.
No vendor-published Data Processing Agreement (DPA) or subprocessor list was found on public pages; likely available under contract for enterprise customers but unconfirmed publicly.

No explicit disclosure of whether the newer 'Recorded Future AI' / Autonomous Threat Operations features train on customer data, despite heavy AI marketing on the homepage; no AI-governance certification (ISO/IEC 42001, CSA STAR AI) held.
Company was acquired by Mastercard (deal closed December 2024); prior majority owner was Insight Partners. Relevant context for procurement/data-flow questions, not itself a security gap.
